gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1176 reported an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 39.487m and disclosed a release of prior year technical reserves of GBP 9.5m in 2014. The release reflects generally favourable claims development and lower-than-expected settlements on certain prior events (notably a South African medical isotope plant claim which settled below prior reserves). Offsetting movements included specific losses and recent reserves (for example Urenco in the UK and a material damage exposure in China) and an outstanding Reinsurance-to-Close nuclear claim reserved in Yen for Hamaoka. Overall the net prior year movement is a material release driven by favourable developments across older years.
